other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Encoding for Linear Models
other_failure_modes.description: Nominal categorical variables are label-encoded (assigned arbitrary integers) and then scaled. While tree models can partition these somewhat effectively, it imposes false, invalid ordinal relationships that harm linear models like Ridge.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline and trains an ensemble of gradient boosting and linear models using KFold cross-validation. However, it computes imputation medians before the CV split (leaking validation data into training), fails to compute an internal validation score to estimate generalization, uses arbitrary hardcoded ensemble weights without tuning, and inappropriately feeds label-encoded nominal variables into a Ridge regression model.
